user.title: Choose your light set
user.description: Light sets that advertise the expected Bluetooth service are marked with ★. Switch the light set on and stay close to your Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

abort.already_configured: This light set is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth devices found. Switch the light set on and try again.

init.title: Connection
init.description: Keep connected: like the app, the Bluetooth connection stays open so commands react at once. Turn it off if you also want to use the phone app; the connection is then released 30 seconds after the last command.
